Title: Guest access available for Azure Machine Learning

Body.Content: The latest release of Azure Machine Learning allows users to explore Azure Machine Learning Studio with no log-in required! You can try out the many available modules, create experiments, and use Azure Machine Learning without having a Microsoft account. This release also contains several improvements, including various UI and documentation updates, and the ability to copy experiments between workspaces. Please see the full list of improvements and guest access restrictions in the Machine Learning release notes.

The latest release of Azure Machine Learning allows users to explore Azure Machine Learning Studio with no log-in required! You can try out the many available modules, create experiments, and use Azure Machine Learning without having a Microsoft account.

This release also contains several improvements, including various UI and documentation updates, and the ability to copy experiments between workspaces.

Please see the full list of improvements and guest access restrictions in the Machine Learning release notes .
